answer: Forging 430 of these means building 430 separate loom records from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The inlet is the wall and the plume is the gate: The defence rests on weaver guild tenure with loom registration records: a loom registered with one guild across many years. A farm of 430 aliases must climb the wall 430 times, the ember ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
